candidates.claim: ACL CORP_IN, bound to the corp interface, has an effective permit at pos 2 for all IP traffic from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.10.0/24 (OT), so CORP can open connections directly into OT.
candidates.remediation: Restore the baseline deny entry for CORP to OT in CORP_IN, or remove the permit, so CORP cannot reach OT.

candidates.claim: ACL CORP_IN, bound to the corp interface, permits all IP traffic from CORP to OT at pos 2, which is not one of the approved cross-zone services (A1-A7).
candidates.remediation: Restore the baseline deny entry for CORP to OT in CORP_IN, or remove the permit, so CORP to OT traffic is limited to approved services.
